description: Cloud project management: Create a new translation project from a GitHub repository (repo_url is required). ZIP projects cannot be created here: their archive must be uploaded first, via the dashboard (Upload ZIP) or `babelize init --source zip`. Requires BABELIZE_API_KEY.

repo_url.description: GitHub repository URL, e.g. https://github.com/org/repo. Required.

name: babelize_project_create
title: Create Project
